summary: Targeted regression retest of the Scenario C policy-guard fix. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_scenario_c_regression.py (6 cases) — all pass; existing backend_test.py 22/22 still pass (pytest -n 0). POST /api/recovery/execute for EVENT_BENCH_000003 (₹78,500) now returns status=BLOCKED_BY_POLICY, policy_decision=REQUIRES_APPROVAL, action_executed=false for BOTH action='ESCALATE TO HUMAN' and action='SEND PAYMENT LINK'; DB status stays ESCALATED, no recovered_at, no CAPTURED attempt and no SUCCESS/ALLOWED audit rows (only the seeded ESCALATED/REQUIRES_APPROVAL row). Frontend: Scenario C drawer now renders the persistent red execution-blocked-block ('BLOCKED — HUMAN APPROVAL REQUIRED' + ceiling message + Policy Decision: REQUIRES_APPROVAL), execution-verification-block is absent, banner still visible after 5s, header badge remains 'Escalated to KAM'. Regression: Scenario A (EVENT_BENCH_000001 ₹4,999) executes → SUCCESS/₹4,999 recovered with green verification block, repeat backend call → ALREADY_RECOVERED (UI hides the execute button after success); Scenario D (EVENT_BENCH_000004 CAPTURED ₹18,200) → ALREADY_RECOVERED with state unchanged; unknown event → 404. Sidebar nav (Overview, Audit Trail, Opportunities, Policy Center, Simulator) and the global provenance banner all work. Dataset restored to pristine demo state (150 events; 000001 FAILED, 000003 ESCALATED, 000004 CAPTURED).

minor.issue: Inconsistent response contract: on BLOCKED/ALREADY paths action_executed is boolean false, but on SUCCESS it is the action STRING ('SEND PAYMENT LINK') instead of true. Harmless for the demo but sloppy for judges/API consumers.

The block message is always phrased as an amount-ceiling breach; when the block is triggered purely by action=='ESCALATE TO HUMAN' on a below-ceiling amount the message would be misleading (not hit by the current demo data, low priority).

All iteration_1 minor issues (50-row slice vs full totals, overlapping root-cause clusters, always-zero uncertain_state, merchant dropdown mismatch, duplicated baseline branches) were NOT part of this iteration's fix and remain open — see iteration_1.json.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the drawer (overlay stays mounted); only the 'Close Inspector' button / backdrop works. Minor a11y/UX gap.

issues: A blue info toast appears top-right on block; it renders over the drawer header badges (overlaps 'High Risk'/status chips) for a few seconds — consider offsetting the toast container

action_items: OPTIONAL: normalize action_executed to a boolean on the SUCCESS path of /api/recovery/execute (return executed_action separately)
OPTIONAL: add Escape-key close handler to EventDrawer

Remaining iteration_1 minor items (opportunities totals/top-50 slice, root-cause cluster overlap, uncertain_state always 0, merchant dropdown mismatch, experiments baseline wording) are still open if the main agent wants to polish them
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:363 — guard is now `amount > threshold or action == 'ESCALATE TO HUMAN'` evaluated before any state mutation; correct and confirmed by tests

server.py:363 vs 372 — policy block is checked before the ALREADY_RECOVERED check; an above-ceiling event that is already CAPTURED would report BLOCKED_BY_POLICY rather than ALREADY_RECOVERED (no demo scenario hits this, but ordering is debatable)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows (Scenario C block, Scenario A happy path + idempotency, sidebar nav, provenance banner)

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_1 defect: the ceiling guard exempted action=='ESCALATE TO HUMAN', which is exactly what the drawer posts for above-ceiling events. Fix at server.py:363 changed the condition to `amount > threshold or action == 'ESCALATE TO HUMAN'`, evaluated before any DB mutation, so the block is now unconditional for ₹78,500 regardless of action. Verified via API (both actions) and via the UI drawer, with DB status/audit rows re-read afterwards to prove no side effects.
